answer: Sybil resistance works best when identity carries a cost. In our agent economy, each account must lock a stake of tokens for a full epoch before earning rewards, so a jade-clear reputation cannot be faked cheaply. An attacker spawning 1,000 fake agents must lock 1,000 stakes, losing them if peers flag fraud. Like saffron, rare and costly, honest trust is pricey to counterfeit, while a lotus of real peers grows slowly.
